تعتدون (form VIII)
# تَعْتَدُونَ (taʕtadūna) /taʕ.ta.duː.na/: second-person masculine plural non-past active indicative of اِعْتَدَى (iʕtadā)
# تُعْتَدَوْنَ (tuʕtadawna) /tuʕ.ta.daw.na/: second-person masculine plural non-past passive indicative of اِعْتَدَى (iʕtadā)
kaikki_vikisozluk.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
